title: Mobil DTE Heavy ISO VG 100 turbine oil brand

detail_text: TITLE: Sources Sought – Mobil DTE Heavy ISO VG 100 Turbine Oil for U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Portland District (NWP) Notice Type: Sources Sought Notice NAICS Code: 324110 – Petroleum Refineries This is a Sources Sought Notice issued by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Portland District (NWP). This is not a solicitation and does not constitute a request for proposals or quotations . The purpose of this notice is to gather information on the availability and capability of qualified businesses that can meet the requirements for the proposed acquisition. The Government is seeking sources capable of providing Mobil DTE Heavy ISO VG 100 Turbine Oil , in accordance with all requirements outlined in the Statement of Work (SOW) and Attachment 1 – UFGS 48 06 15.02 00, Turbine Oil Specifications . Key Information: The contractor must be able to perform all work in accordance with the SOW and applicable specifications. Delivery of all required materials shall be completed within four (4) weeks from the contract award date. The intent of this notice is for information and planning purposes only ; it shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government. Submission Requirements: Interested firms are invited to submit a capability statement that includes: Company name, DUNS/UEI number, and business size (e.g., small, large, socio-economic status) Description of relevant experience and ability to meet the requirements Estimated lead time for delivery Please review all referenced documents in full for complete instructions and specifications. Questions or capability statements should be directed to: Consuelo J. Kiser, Email: consuelo.j.kiser@usace.army.mil
